about: restricted coin: wallet to wallet transfers revert unless a side is on the allowlist; coin moves to or from the PoolManager only within the transient allowance the canonical hook grants for a canonical swap, so it trades through the universal router and permit2 with neither allowlisted. The factory seeds the stack escrow, this launch's locker and the launch extensions. List extra entries in restriction.allowed only for contracts whose coin outflows are fixed by their own logic (a fee swapper or burn router deployed for this coin); never list a router, aggregator, multicall or smart wallet, since an allowlisted forwarder reopens wallet to wallet transfers for everyone. The coin admin can add entries, turn restriction off once, and lock both. Replace every treasury placeholder (0x7ea5...0001) and set example to false before a broadcast.
